PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits Agnes's clue ("She was beside the box and a crate."). So Agnes (A) must be at row 1, column 2. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: Using Douglas's clue ("He was exactly two rows north of Cedric."), some squares are ruled out for Cedric. So Cedric (C) must be at row 4, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: With the rows and columns of Agnes and Cedric crossed out, only one square is left for Bonnie that fits her clue ("She was the only woman in the Warehouse."). So Bonnie (B) must be at row 5, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Edith that fits her clue ("She was beside a table."). So Edith (E) must be at row 6, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: The victim must share an area with exactly one other person. So Vaughn (the victim) must be at row 3, column 4. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Douglas that fits his clue ("He was exactly two rows north of Cedric."). So Douglas (D) must be at row 2, column 6. Cross out his row and column. Agnes is the only person in the Shipyard with Vaughn, so Agnes is the murderer!
